plan.sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: Porsche.
Style: pop-art comic style, bold black ink outlines, halftone dot shading, saturated primary colours, dynamic expressive poses.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character is a different moment: a wide range of emotions AND different states of action (standing, walking, running, jumping, sitting, lying down, leaning, reaching, spinning), so no two characters share a pose, a body position or a silhouette:
Character 1: beaming with happiness, bouncing on the spot with a huge smile
Character 2: laughing so hard tears of joy fly out, holding the belly
Character 3: bawling with big streaming tears, rubbing the eyes
Character 4: sad and slumped, head hanging low, a single tear
Character 5: hugging a big red heart, eyes sparkling, blushing
Character 6: furious and stomping, steam puffing from the head, fists clenched
Character 7: winking playfully with a finger-gun and a cheeky grin
Character 8: blowing a kiss from the hand, a small heart floating away
Character 9: jumping back in surprise, wide eyes and an open mouth
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
